nodes.cisza.options.[dowod].text.t: I hear you issue proofs of life, sister.

nodes.cisza.options.[klasztor].text.t: Where do I look for people who vanished from the city?

nodes.cisza.options.[ranni].text.t: Wounded men were brought in from the battlefield.

nodes.cisza.text.t: The sister's voice is quiet as dust on an altar, and her eyes are quicker than a fox's. "The House of Silence takes in those who are lost, and those who found themselves one time too many. Are you after comfort, brother, or rather questions without answers?"

nodes.dom.text.t: "We pray that nobody asks, and we feed the ones who do. The Emperor sends us his sick, and we send him the bill. Everyone knows he never pays, but a bill ought to exist anyway." She smiles, and the smile doesn't reach her eyes.

nodes.dowod.text.t: The sister listens in silence and doesn't interrupt. At the end she pulls a seal from her sleeve and presses it onto a scrap of parchment with cold certainty. "I attest that this man is alive, because I have touched him. Whether he saw what he saw, the seal does not confirm, but neither does it deny." She hands you the paper like a last sacrament.

nodes.klasztor.text.t: "The ones who vanished? Some go to the old monastery outside town, four days' road. There used to be nuns there, now there are only echoes and a few runaways. I'm not saying I left them there. I'm saying I know where to look, if someone asks properly."

nodes.powrot.options.[dowod].text.t: I hear you issue proofs of life, sister.

nodes.powrot.options.[klasztor].text.t: Where do I look for people who vanished from the city?

nodes.powrot.options.[ranni].text.t: Wounded men were brought in from the battlefield.

nodes.powrot.text.t: Sister Jadwiga doesn't look up from the candles she's trimming, but there's something warmer in her voice than last time. "Back again, brother. The House of Silence has patience for those who return. What are you after this time?"

nodes.ranni.text.t: "Yes, I heard. On wagons, in sacks, in somebody's blankets. Some from one side, some from the other, all with the same look. You did well to bring them in, and I don't say it because it sounds nice, only because nobody else here does."
